description: Activate the automatic cadence of ONE draft campaign. Fills the campaign's cadence template with each person's name, company, role and signals into its steps (by default a LinkedIn connection and message first, then e-mail, alternating) and sends them through the selected connected Gmail, LinkedIn and/or WhatsApp accounts. When several accounts are connected on a channel, the account id for that channel is required. A reply stops the person's remaining steps. Activating can send messages immediately when inside the business window. When the campaign has people whose messages come from an earlier version of the template (messagesOutdated), activating first writes those people's messages again and then activates; rewrittenBeforeActivation in the result reports it.

channels.description: Connected channels the user explicitly approved. Omit for a campaign of WhatsApp only: its steps are tasks the sender sends from their own phone, with no account to connect.

linkedinAccountId.description: Connected LinkedIn accountId, required when several LinkedIn accounts are connected.

mailboxId.description: Connected Gmail mailbox UUID, required when several mailboxes are connected.

whatsappAccountId.description: Connected WhatsApp accountId, required when several WhatsApp accounts are connected.
